kpis.description: Share of deliverables due before next gate that are complete.
kpis.name: Next gate readiness
rules: Score = completed_due_before_gate / due_before_gate * 100.

kpis.description: Count and severity of overdue deliverables.
kpis.name: Overdue deliverables
rules: Penalty combines overdue count and max overdue days.

kpis.name: Blocked dependency rate
rules: Score = (1 - blocked_rate) * 100.
Retrospective inference can waive dependency blocks when dependencies are in board-ready chain and at least in_progress.

kpis.description: Readiness of pre-read deliverables for the next gate.
kpis.name: Pre-read readiness
rules: No explicit pre-read fields in timeline.
Retrospective board-ready package publication provides inferred pre-read readiness credit.

kpis.description: No dangling IDs across SoR references.
kpis.name: SoR reference integrity
rules: ID-* issues from quality report reduce score.

kpis.description: Deliverables and workstreams have assigned owners/leads.
kpis.name: Ownership completeness
rules: Owner-related quality issues reduce score.

kpis.description: Deliverables map to valid timeline checkpoints.
kpis.name: Gate mapping completeness
rules: Missing or invalid checkpoint mappings reduce score.

kpis.description: Definition-of-done is sufficiently detailed and not placeholder text.
kpis.name: DoD completeness and placeholder-free
rules: Placeholder DoD bullets reduce score.

kpis.description: Percent of deliverables linked to principles via explicit refs or retrospective inference from the board-ready drafting package.
kpis.name: Principle linkage coverage
rules: Coverage = principle-linked deliverables / total deliverables.
Principle-linked includes explicit principle_refs and retrospective inferred links from the board-ready package dependency chain.

kpis.description: Percent of deliverables linked to risks via explicit refs or retrospective inference from the board-ready drafting package.
kpis.name: Risk linkage coverage
rules: Coverage = risk-linked deliverables / total deliverables.
Risk-linked includes explicit risk_refs and retrospective inferred links from the board-ready package dependency chain.

kpis.description: Percent of scanned docs linked to principles, including retrospective inferred drafting outputs from the board-ready package.
kpis.name: Cross-doc principle coverage
rules: Green >=70, yellow >=40, red <40.
Retrospective drafting outputs from the board-ready package count as inferred principle-linked documents.

kpis.description: Percent of scanned docs linked to risks, including retrospective inferred drafting outputs from the board-ready package.
kpis.name: Cross-doc risk coverage
rules: Green >=70, yellow >=40, red <40.
Retrospective drafting outputs from the board-ready package count as inferred risk-linked documents.

kpis.description: Coverage of risk-linked deliverables that are also principle-linked, including retrospective inference from the board-ready package.
kpis.name: Risk→principle mapping readiness
rules: Risk→principle mapping = risk-linked deliverables that are also principle-linked / all risk-linked deliverables.
Risk-linked and principle-linked include explicit refs and retrospective inferred links from the board-ready package dependency chain.

kpis.description: Deliverables are checkpointed against timeline milestones/gates, with retrospective gate inference enabled when the board-ready package is present.
kpis.name: Milestone gating consistency
rules: Primary mapping uses ms_* checkpoints.
When board-ready package is present, retrospective inference also counts m* gate checkpoints that are present in timeline.yml.

kpis.description: SoR files updated within freshness window, with optional retrospective recency credit when the board-ready package was freshly published.
kpis.name: SoR recency
rules: Files older than 7 days are stale.
If the board-ready package ingest is fresh, apply retrospective recency credit.

kpis.description: Derived public artifacts are freshly generated.
kpis.name: Public artifacts recency
rules: Public artifacts should be updated within 7 days.
If board-ready package ingest is fresh, apply retrospective recency credit.

kpis.description: Recency profile for governance_docs and project_files updates, with retrospective board-ready publication credit.
kpis.name: Foundation docs recency
rules: P75 age <=14 days => green; <=30 days => yellow; >30 days => red.
A recent board-ready package publication can raise the score to at least yellow.

kpis.description: Completed deliverables must have public_url or committee_only=true, and public_url should resolve to an ingested output.
kpis.name: Public link hygiene
rules: Only completed, non-committee-only deliverables are scored for link hygiene.

kpis.description: Public outputs should not include email addresses.
kpis.name: PII lint
rules: Any email-like token in public/*.json is red.

categories.convergence: Internal consistency and linkage quality across SoR and docs.
categories.freshness: How recent SoR and supporting documents are.
categories.schedule: Timeline and readiness metrics for near-term execution.
